name: Net.Bit Datacentar Veles
notes: Net.Bit's own site lists a Net.Bit Datacentar address at Nikola Orovcanec 11 St., 1400 Veles, and describes its datacenter as operational, providing managed services for data storage/processing, hosting, colocation, disaster recovery, secure backup, SaaS and outsourced IT operations. Data Center Map independently describes the datacenter business unit as located in Veles. No public MW capacity found.

name: Government Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Data Centre - Kavadarci candidate scenarios
developer: Government of North Macedonia / Ministry of Interior; EU IPA support
notes: EU IPA project fiche/feasibility summary identified Kavadarci scenarios for adapting an existing building as a Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Data Centre, including 60-120 rack options and estimated data-centre costs of EUR 1.4m-3.1m plus ICT/equipment. Later IPA reporting says the state-of-the-art BCDR Data Centre was in Prilep, indicating the Kavadarci candidate was not the final implemented site. No public MW capacity found.
